_about: The 12 keywords (locked). The rules are in core/tcg/match_state.gd; text = what the card's hover shows.

guard.name: Guard
guard.text: Enemies must attack a Guard first.

plated.name: Plated
plated.text: The first damage it takes is ignored.

rush.name: Rush
rush.text: Can attack creatures the turn it is played.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Can attack anything the turn it is played.

arrival.name: Arrival
arrival.text: Does something when you play it.

drain.name: Drain
drain.text: Damage it deals heals your leader.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.text: Cannot be attacked or picked by the enemy until it attacks.

wind_up.name: Wind-up
wind_up.text: Gets +1/+1 at the start of your turn.
